newsitem.title: USA: Nematron settles litigation against Xycom.
newsitem.headline: Nematron settles litigation against Xycom.

text.p: Nematron Corp said Wednesday it settled its litigation against Xycom Corp of Saline, Mich.

Under the terms of the settlement, reached March 14, a full and final discharge of all prior claims was agreed upon, with each party bearing its own legal expenses. Nematron said its costs of settlement were immaterial.

In addition, Nematron's NemaSoft Inc subsidiary will grant a non-exclusive technology license for its patented flowchart programming technology to a Xycom unit for an undisclosed sum. No other rights related to copyrights have been granted.

"We are pleased that Xycom will promote our patented flowchart technology through its subsidiary software company," Frank Logan, III, Nematron president, said in a statement. NemaSoft was granted a patent in 1989 that covers continuous flowchart, improved data format, and debugging system for programming and operation of machines, Nematron said.
NemaTron designs and manufactures personal computer-based industrial automation products that include software for direct machine control, process visualization and data acquisition.
